name: live_dialogue_dlc_speaker
description: A Dead Money talking activator, in the police station basement. The God speaker taunts the player: NVDCL01PoliceStationSpeakerREF.SayTo Player NVDLC01DogDialogueGodBasementBark 1, the line of script 01012BB0, twice (its say-once lines in turn). Each call reaches GameState::coop_talk, and DialogueBridge::forced_frame says the line to everyone through a host session on the speaker. The host said two lines, and both peers played both.
